rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial description of a person or animal visibly twisting or wriggling.

example.english: That worm is so squirmy that it makes my eyes go funny.
example.traditional: 條蟲扭嚟扭去，睇到我眼都花。
example.jyutping: tiu4 cung4 nau2 lai4 nau2 heoi3 tai2 dou2 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1

rows.note: Use this especially for a person or child fidgeting restlessly rather than for something visibly writhing.

example.english: That kid is so squirmy and can't sit still.
example.traditional: 個細路坐唔定，成日郁身郁勢。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 co5 m4 ding6 seng4 jat6 juk1 san1 juk1 sai3
